# MoveMonkey

> MoveMonkey is a stand-up reminder for iPhone and Apple Watch with a cartoon monkey as its character. It reminds you to get up when you have been sitting too long, and cheers when you do. Chinese store name (Simplified and Traditional): MoveMonkey：久坐提醒 (久坐提醒 means "sedentary reminder", a reminder to get up after sitting too long).

## What it does

- Within the reminder hours you set (08:00 to 21:00 by default), it counts the time since you last got up. Once you have sat for the time you choose (30, 45, 60, or 90 minutes; 60 by default), your iPhone sends a notification, and Apple Watch reminds you too if you wear one.
- It reads stand minutes, stand hours, and steps (with your permission, from the Health app and Motion & Fitness) to tell whether you have been up and moving. When it sees that you have, the clock starts over, so moving pushes the next reminder back.
- Get Up: tap it and walk for 1 minute; Apple Watch counts your steps in real time (without Apple Watch, iPhone counts them), and the monkey cheers for you when the minute is up.
- When you start Get Up on iPhone, a Live Activity shows the walk's time on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
- Just Moved: tell it you just got up, and the clock starts over.
- Today's stand hours count toward a daily stand goal (10 hours by default); on the day you reach it you earn a banana award. Every day starts at zero.
- Pause reminders for a few hours or for the rest of the day; set a lunch break with no reminders; in the morning it waits until you are up (2 hours at most).
- Works with iPhone alone; Apple Watch is optional.

## What it is not

- Not a medical device; it makes no health claims and gives no medical advice.
- No account, no ads, no analytics or tracking code. Health data stays on your devices. To remind you on time, the devices send the developer's server only the reminder times they work out, with a push token (the privacy policy lists everything sent and kept).

## Facts

- Platforms: iPhone with iOS 18 or later; Apple Watch with watchOS 10 or later.
- Languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese.
- Price: free.
- Category: Health & Fitness.
- Developer: an independent developer.
- Contact: movemonkey@billys.fun
